scripts.app:dryrun: npm run build:client && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.app.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .local/app-dryrun
scripts.app:dev: npm run build:client && wrangler dev --config wrangler.app.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:client && node tests/e2e.mjs
scripts.preview:synthetic: npm run build && npm run build:client && node tests/browser-fixture.mjs
scripts.uat: npm run build && npm run build:client && node tests/uat.mjs
scripts.test:uat: npm run build && npm run build:client && node tests/uat-controls.mjs
scripts.test:auth-ui: npm run build && npm run build:client && node tests/auth-ui.mjs
